#### [Cell size reduction distinctly scales spindle elongation and chromosome segregation in C. elegans](<https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-026-76360-3>)
*Chukwuebuka William Okafornta, Reza Farhadifar, Gunar Fabig, Hai-Yin Wu, Maria Köckert, Martin Vogel, Daniel Baum, Robert Haase, Michael J. Shelley, Daniel J. Needleman, Thomas Müller-Reichert* <br>
Mid-spindle microtubules mediate cell-size-invariant chromosome segregation while astral microtubules drive size-dependent spindle elongation, a mechanistic divergence explained by a predictive stoichiometric model that accurately captures spindle and nuclear dynamics across development and across species.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
#### [EpiCure (Epithelial Curation): a versatile and handy tool for curation of epithelial segmentation](<https://doi.org/10.1242/dev.205701>)
*Gaëlle Letort, Léo Valon, Arthur Michaut, Tom Cumming, Laura Xénard, Minh-Son Phan, Nicolas Dray, Curtis T. Rueden, François Schweisguth, Jérôme Gros, Laure Bally-Cuif, Jean-Yves Tinevez, Romain Levayer* <br>
EpiCure automatically identifies and corrects segmentation and tracking errors using temporal and morphometric data, offering ergonomic visualization and flexible pipeline integration to ensure accurate analysis of single-cell dynamics in large tissue movies.
:::
